name: Ryou Sakazaki
source: After losing his mother at a young age, Ryo had to care for both himself and his younger sister Yuri when his father left to seek revenge. He is best friends and rivals with Robert, and unlike his best friend he has little taste when it comes to fashion and culture. Blunt and disciplined, he recognizes his flaws and believes that all can be overcome through hard work. He is very passionate about his father's dojo.
